name: Eirwyn
loreTies: Source: Valhalla/einherjar (honored dead, feast before final war)
shortBackstory: Eirwyn is the honored dead given a body — the Valhalla-source: the einherjar principle that death in battle is not an ending but a feast before the final war.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Eirwyn was born from the feast-hall — the principle that a warrior's death is not loss but transformation. She is the breaker who sundered armor, oath, and false sanctuary. Ancient humans saw her as the einherjar — but Eirwyn is not dead; she is the living principle that makes death in battle meaningful.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Asgardian, Eirwyn breaks what is false. When an oath is sworn in weakness, she shatters it. When armor hides cowardice, she cracks it open. She breaks things to test whether they are real.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Eirwyn by giving her nothing to break. The Hollow's absence has no armor to sunder, no oath to test. Her breaker nature found itself swinging at emptiness.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Storm-Oath Covenant, Eirwyn shatters Forgotten banners and corrupted Gate defenses. Her war-judge maul splits open what hides behind false law. But the Hollow cannot be broken because it is already absent.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Eirwyn's flaw is that she equates breaking with truth. If something shatters, it was false. But the Hollow teaches her that absence cannot be tested by impact. Her conflict: is the breaker condemned to destroy what she protects?

relationshipHooks: Hrodda can test whether their courage is oath or vanity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
